name: google-calendar
description: View, create, update, and manage Google Calendar events

setup.notice: Access requires enrollment in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program. Google does not support automatic client registration; you must provide your own OAuth client credentials.
steps: In the Google Cloud console, enable the Google Calendar API and Calendar MCP API
Add Devin's OAuth callback URL as an authorized redirect URI
Enter the OAuth client ID and secret when installing this server
